fund_name.value: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P.
fund_name.quote: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P. (the "Fund") is a closed-end, drawdown private investment fund organized as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 3, 2024.

fund_domicile.quote: organized as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 3, 2024

fund_structure.value: Closed-end, drawdown private credit fund with a finite life. Not a master-feeder. Limited Partners make binding capital commitments drawn down over time; there are no redemption or withdrawal rights and no liquidity prior to ordinary-course distributions or final liquidation.
fund_structure.quote: Unlike an open-end hedge fund, the Fund is a closed-end vehicle with a finite life. Limited Partners make binding capital commitments that are drawn down over time, and there are no redemption rights, no withdrawal rights, and no liquidity prior to distributions made in the ordinary course or the final liquidation of the Fund.

management_fee.value: 1.50% per annum, payable quarterly in advance. During the Investment Period charged on aggregate capital commitment whether or not drawn; thereafter charged on invested capital in unrealized investments at cost, reducing as investments are realized. Cliff-tiered by commitment: 1.50% below $50m, 1.35% at $50m-$99.99m, 1.25% at $100m+, less an additional 10bp for Fund II investors. 100% of transaction, origination, monitoring, break-up and directors' fees offset the Management Fee dollar-for-dollar, net of unreimbursed out-of-pocket expenses, with excess carried forward.
management_fee.quote: During the Investment Period, the Management Fee is charged at an annual rate of 1.50% of each Limited Partner's aggregate capital commitment, whether or not drawn.

performance_fee.value: 20% carried interest, calculated on a whole-of-fund (European) basis rather than deal-by-deal. No carry is distributed until LPs have received all capital contributions in respect of all investments, fees and expenses, plus the preferred return. Subject to an after-tax, severally guaranteed clawback with interim tests from the sixth anniversary of final closing.
performance_fee.quote: The Carried Interest is 20% of profits, subject to the 7% preferred return and the 80/20 catch-up described above.

hurdle_rate.value: 7% per annum preferred return, compounded annually, on capital contributions (including those funding the Management Fee, expenses and written-off investments), followed by an 80/20 GP catch-up until the GP has received 20% of amounts distributed in the preferred return and catch-up tiers, then an 80/20 residual split.
hurdle_rate.quote: Second - Preferred Return. 100% to the Limited Partners until each Limited Partner has received a cumulative preferred return of 7% per annum, compounded annually, on the amounts described in the First tier.

high_water_mark.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - the document expressly states there is no high water mark. A high water mark is a feature of open-end funds charging a periodic performance allocation on unrealized appreciation; this Fund charges Carried Interest only on realized distributions through the waterfall.
high_water_mark.quote: There is no high water mark. A high water mark is a feature of open-end funds that charge a periodic performance allocation on unrealized appreciation; the Fund charges Carried Interest only on realized distributions through the waterfall described above.

minimum_initial_investment.value: $10,000,000 minimum capital commitment. The General Partner may accept less at its discretion and expects to accept commitments of not less than $1,000,000 from individuals and family investment vehicles affiliated with the Sponsor's existing investor base.
minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum capital commitment for a Limited Partner is $10,000,000.

lockup_period.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - as a closed-end drawdown fund there is no redemption mechanism and therefore no lock-up in the open-end sense. Capital is committed for the life of the Fund; the only route to early liquidity is a secondary transfer requiring General Partner consent.
lockup_period.quote: There is no lock-up period as that term is used in open-end funds, because there is no mechanism by which a Limited Partner may redeem.

redemption_frequency.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - the Fund offers no redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind.
redemption_frequency.quote: The Fund does not offer redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind.

redemption_notice_days.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - no redemptions are permitted, so no notice period exists.
redemption_notice_days.quote: There is no redemption notice period, no redemption frequency, and no gate provision, because no redemptions are permitted.

gate_provision.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - no gate exists because no redemptions are permitted.
gate_provision.quote: There is no redemption notice period, no redemption frequency, and no gate provision, because no redemptions are permitted.

key_man_provision.value: Yes - a Key Person Event occurs if both Rosalind Adeyemi-Clarke and Theodore Vance Kirkpatrick, or any three of the four investment committee members, cease to devote substantially all business time to the Sponsor and the Fund during the Investment Period. Effect is automatic suspension of the Investment Period (no new investments other than follow-ons and prior commitments); reinstatement requires a majority-in-interest vote within 180 days or the Investment Period terminates permanently. No redemption right arises, as the Fund permits no redemptions.
key_man_provision.quote: A "Key Person Event" occurs if both Rosalind Adeyemi-Clarke and Theodore Vance Kirkpatrick, or any three (3) of the four (4) members of the investment committee, cease to devote substantially all of their business time to the affairs of the Sponsor and the Fund during the Investment Period.

gp_commitment.value: Not less than 2.0% of aggregate commitments, subject to a $20,000,000 minimum and a $30,000,000 maximum, from the General Partner, Sponsor, principals, employees, affiliates and estate planning vehicles. At least 50% must be funded in cash rather than through Management Fee waiver. GP capital bears no Management Fee and no Carried Interest.
gp_commitment.quote: shall make an aggregate capital commitment to the Fund of not less than 2.0% of aggregate commitments, subject to a minimum of $20,000,000 and a maximum of $30,000,000

fund_term.value: 8 years from the final closing date (Initial Term), extendable by up to two consecutive one-year periods - the first with Advisory Committee consent, the second with majority-in-interest LP consent - for a maximum term of 10 years, plus a wind-up extension not exceeding 12 months. Separately, the Investment Period runs to the 5th anniversary of the final closing.
fund_term.quote: Accordingly, the maximum term of the Fund is ten (10) years from the final closing date, subject to a further extension solely for the purpose of winding up, which shall not exceed twelve (12) months.

auditor.value: Halloran Meade & Co. LLP - independent registered public accounting firm. Fiscal year ends December 31; audited annuals within 120 days, unaudited quarterlies within 60 days.
auditor.quote: Halloran Meade & Co. LLP has been engaged as the Fund's independent registered public accounting firm.

administrator.value: Pemberton Vaux Fund Administration LLC - responsible for capital account maintenance, capital call and distribution processing, and quarterly investor statements.
administrator.quote: Pemberton Vaux Fund Administration LLC serves as the administrator to the Fund

prime_broker.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - the Fund has expressly not appointed a prime broker. It does not engage in short selling, securities lending or margin trading. Loan assets and collateral are held by Renwick Trust, N.A. as custodian and collateral agent.
prime_broker.quote: The Fund has not appointed a prime broker. The Fund does not engage in short selling, securities lending or margin trading, and accordingly no prime brokerage relationship is required.

legal_counsel.value: Ashford Petrakis & Lowe LLP - counsel to the Fund, the General Partner and the Sponsor. Does not represent the Limited Partners.
legal_counsel.quote: Ashford Petrakis & Lowe LLP serves as counsel to the Fund, the General Partner and the Sponsor.

mfn_election.value: Yes - the Fund provides an MFN election. A side letter summary schedule is delivered within 60 days of final closing and LPs have 30 days to elect. Scope is tiered by commitment: $100m+ may elect any term; $50m-$99.99m may elect terms granted to LPs committing $100m or less; below $50m may elect terms granted to LPs committing equal to or less than their own. Economic terms (fee and carry reductions), Advisory Committee seats, and capacity/co-investment priority rights are excluded at all tiers.
mfn_election.quote: The Fund provides a most favored nation ("MFN") election. Within sixty (60) days following the final closing, the General Partner shall deliver to each Limited Partner a schedule summarizing the material terms granted in all side letters.
